title: Chiyo

{{NPC infobox | affiliation = Canthans | type = Human | profession = rt | level = 20 | service = Henchman | campaign = Factions }} [[Chiyo]] is [[Emi]]'s twin sister and a close friend of [[Mhenlo]]. She is available as a henchman in some parts of [[Cantha]]. She is labeled as a [[Spirit Henchman]]. ==Locations== {{TOCright}} ;[[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] *[[Kaineng City]] **{{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}} (only during [[Welcome to Cantha]]) **{{NPC location|Divine Path}} **{{NPC location|Dragon's Throat|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Maatu Keep}} **{{NPC location|Nahpui Quarter|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Senji's Corner}} **{{NPC location|Sunjiang District|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Tahnnakai Temple|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter)}} **{{NPC location|Zin Ku Corridor}} *[[The Jade Sea]] **{{NPC location|Boreas Seabed|outpost}} ==Skills== ====Henchman==== 11 [[Channeling Magic]], 12 [[Restoration Magic]]
13 or 14 Channeling Magic as ally in [[Vizunah Square]] *{{skill icon|Essence Strike}} *{{skill icon|Flesh of My Flesh}} *{{skill icon|Mend Body and Soul}} *{{skill icon|Protective Was Kaolai}} *{{skill icon|Signet of Spirits}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Soothing Memories}} *{{skill icon|Spirit Siphon}} *{{skill icon|Vengeful Weapon}} ====Ally==== '''During Welcome to Cantha''' 15 [[Communing]], 14 [[Restoration Magic]] *{{skill icon|Displacement}} *{{skill icon|Flesh of My Flesh}} *{{skill icon|Recuperation}} *{{skill icon|Spirit Light}} *{{skill icon|Spirit Light Weapon}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Union}} ==Evaluation== ;Pros * Can provide healing and damage. * Possesses active [[energy management]] recovery skills. * Can remove [[condition]]s (only if spirits are within range). * Her spirits provide offensive power and some utility (synergy with other Ritualists). * [[Flesh of My Flesh]] has twice the range of [[Resurrection Chant]] ([[Danika]]'s and [[Sister Tai]]'s resurrection skill), and can bring back dead party members after a fight quickly, due to its cheap cost, fast cast, and no recharge. * Her skills retain most-to-all effectiveness even if there are no [[spirit]]s in range, or if she is unable to utilize an [[item spell]]. ;Cons * Cannot remove [[hex]]es (unlike Sister Tai). * Flesh of My Flesh resurrects with only half as much Health as Resurrection Chant (available from other henchmen); it also causes her to lose half of her health, which can leave her vulnerable in the middle of a fight. * Due to inherent AI mechanics, her spirits may idle during battles (or attack only sporadically) while she's holding an item spell. ==Dialogue== ;Bukdek Byway (during [[Welcome to Cantha]]): :''"My sister and I grew up in the monastery, and Mhenlo was much like an older brother to us. He helped us with our studies and defended us against the older bullies. Emi always said she would marry him someday, but we were only children then."'' ;Kaineng City towns and outposts: :''"As children growing up in [[Seitung Harbor]], my twin sister Emi and I were often picked on for being different and strange. When our father enrolled us at the [[Shing Jea Monastery]] our fellow students took up where the children from the Harbor left off, continuing the taunting that accompanied us wherever we went. It was Mhenlo and [[Jamei]] who made the others stop picking on us. My sister and I owe him a great deal for helping see us through such hard times; I think Emi still has a crush on him.'' :''Did you need anything?"'' ;Divine Path: :''"It was good to see Mhenlo again, but I have to admit I am happy to see his [[Cynn|little blonde friend]] leave."'' ==Quotes== ;Kaineng City: :''"Do we stop to commune with the spirits?"'' :''"I am sure the [[Suun|Oracle]] watches us even now."'' :''"My sister had quite a crush on Mhenlo when we were young you know."'' :''"The [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry]] is a farce; they defame the good name of the Oracle."'' :''"The Oracle expects great things of us."'' ===Battle quotes=== :''"Do not expect an easy fight."'' :''"Do not take me for some weak little girl. The spirits fill me with strength."'' :''"Guide me spirits, help my weapon strike true."'' :''"Peering into the mists I see your doom is at hand."'' :''"Perhaps I shall bind your spirit to me when I am done with you."'' :''"Spirits guide me!"'' :''"The spirits knew this battle would occur."'' ==Trivia== *Her henchman skills were updated in the [[Game updates/20091022#Factions|22nd October 2009 update]]. **This added [[Essence Strike]], [[Protective Was Kaolai]], [[Signet of Spirits]] (elite), [[Spirit Siphon]], and [[Vengeful Weapon]], and removed [[Attuned Was Songkai]] (elite), [[Shelter]], [[Spirit Light]], and [[Weapon of Warding]] from her skills. {{Henchmen nav|Factions}} [[Category:Ritualist henchmen]]
